subject: Append histograms to hexbin scatter plot

messages.author: 240605e088db79ab
messages.subject: Append histograms to hexbin scatter plot
parts:
Hello ggplotters,

I would like to add histograms on the top and side of a hexbin scatter plot similar to a scatterplot with histograms.  

I have included my hexbin code and am wondering if any one can suggest a solution to add the histograms.  I have also included an image of the result figure of my code and a facsimile of the histogram scatter plot I am trying to obtain.

test.csv file file is attached.

Thanks in advance.

Best, 
Art

ctb.fiber <- ggplot(test, aes(distance, angle)) + 
  stat_binhex(aes(fill = cut(..count.., c(0, 1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60), labels = c('0-1', '1-5', '5-10', '10-15', '15-30', '30-60')))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(type = 'seq', pal = 'PuBu') +
  theme_bw() +
  opts(legend.title = theme_blank())
print(ctb.fiber)

messages.subject: Re: Append histograms to hexbin scatter plot
parts:
Hi:

This should get you fairly close; you may want to tweak a few of the settings I used. The legend of the hexbin plot was pulled inside in order to get the histograms to abut the boundaries of the hexbin plot.

library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

test <- read.csv('test.csv', header = TRUE)
rd <- range(test$distance)
ra <- range(test$angle)

# Hexbin plot

theme_bw() + xlim(rd[1], rd[2]) + ylim(ra[1], ra[2]) +
  opts(legend.title = theme_blank(), legend.position = c(0.9, 0.33),
       plot.background = theme_blank())
# Histogram for distances
histd <- ggplot(test, aes(x = distance)) +
     geom_histogram(fill = 'steelblue') +
     xlim(rd[1], rd[2]) +
     xlab("") + opts(axis.text.x = theme_blank(),
                     plot.background = theme_blank())
# Histogram for angles (rotated)
hista <- ggplot(test, aes(x = angle)) +
     geom_histogram(fill = 'steelblue') +
     xlim(ra[1], ra[2]) +
     xlab("") + opts(axis.text.y = theme_blank(),
                     plot.background = theme_blank()) + coord_flip()

# Define viewports with specified widths, heights and centers
vp1 <- viewport(width = 0.8, height = 0.8, x = 0.4, y = 0.4)
vp2 <- viewport(width = 0.8, height = 0.35, x = 0.42, y = 0.85)
vp3 <- viewport(width = 0.3, height = 0.8, x = 0.875, y = 0.4)
grid.newpage()
print(ctb.fiber, vp = vp1)
print(histd, vp = vp2)
print(hista, vp = vp3)

HTH,
Dennis
